verdict.rationale: Vestd offers shareholder dashboards (vestd-docs-37, vestd-probe via shareholder-dashboards page) and dedicated shareholder communication tools including targeted updates and mailing lists (vestd-docs-3, vestd-docs-13, vestd-docs-24), which directly supports investors having self-service visibility and structured updates rather than emailing the founder. However, evidence is all first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on confirmation of the investor-side experience or what 'structured updates' concretely look like (e.g. automated reports vs manual email blasts). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the investor portal UX, detail on automated/structured update formats, and confirmation that portal access is self-serve without founder intervention.
